$comment: Provisions that set a MINIMUM a band row cannot undercut.
MPD-2021 p.64 (ii): coverage and FAR in any plot 'shall not be less than
that permissible and available to the largest plot in the next lower
category'. The engine resolves band rows one at a time, so without this
file it served a row's ratio even where that gives less than the largest
plot below already has — FAR 225% on a 300 m² plot is 675 m², where the
row below gives a 250 m² plot 750 m² at 300%.
An entry here is a citation, not a value: which parameters and which
documents the provision governs, and its words verbatim. The runtime uses
it only to DECLINE where a row is undercut. It does not compute the higher
figure — whether the minimum is an area, and how it interacts with
setbacks and height, is a reading for the verifier (docs/tasks.md).
MPD-2047 (p.177, iii) and the UBBL 2016 compendium (p.153, ii) carry the
same words. Add an entry for a document when its FAR or coverage rules are
verified: applies_to_docs scopes the clause to the rows it governs, so an
MPD-2021 citation can never be shown against an MPD-2047 number.

citation.original_text: The total coverage and FAR permissible in any plot in a category, shall not be less than that permissible and available to the largest plot in the next lower category.
